versions.changelog:
web-design-guidelines skill v1.0.0

- Initial release for automated UI review against the latest Web Interface Guidelines.
- Dynamically fetches and applies up-to-date rules from the official guidelines repository before each review.
- Supports terse, file:line formatted audit output per guidelines instructions.
- Prompts for files to check if none specified; reviews individual files or patterns as requested.
- Connects findings to remediation guidance via the ui-ux-pro-max skill for accessibility, forms, animation, navigation, and layout issues.
